description: This file defines the ProfileReader class responsible for retrieving user profile information within the Profiles feature of the application. It interacts with the database to fetch user data, maps domain objects to DTOs, and handles authorization and error handling.

classes.name: ProfileReader
classes.description: A class that handles reading user profile data, including checking follow status and error handling.

methods.name: ReadProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a user profile by username, including follow status based on the current user, and throws exceptions if the user is not found.
